name: R.C. Durr YMCA
limitations: Public-source information only; no on-site audit. The main branch page’s undated indoor-pool closure message and the fall promotion’s year-round claim are unresolved; confirm operation directly. The outdoor splash pool’s zero-depth entry must not be transferred to the indoor pool. Pool lifts, equipment operation, transfer assistance, accessible changing/toilets, parking-to-door route, door controls and route dimensions remain unverified. Reservation instructions do not establish accommodation eligibility or guarantee staff assistance. The promotion’s crowding guidance is an expectation, not a live occupancy report.
facts: The main branch page displays “Indoor Pool Closed, Opens Sept 8” without a year. Confirm indoor-pool operation before travelling; the branch phone is 859-534-5700.
Indoor Lap Swim Indoor Pool Closed, Opens Sept 8
The branch’s fall promotion describes an outdoor zero-depth splash pool and shaded seating, and says the outdoor pool is closed for the season. This does not establish an indoor-pool entry method.
Slides, a zero-depth splash pool, and shaded seating. Closed for the season, but included with membership when it reopens next summer.
The branch’s fall promotion describes the indoor pool as open year-round. Confirm current operation rather than treating the promotional description as an outage check.
The main branch page advises reserving a class or lap lane to guarantee space; reservations open 48 hours before the desired time.
Reserve a class or lap lane to guarantee your space. Reservations open 48 hours before desired time.

The fall promotion identifies weekday evenings, 5–7 p.m., and Saturday mornings as peak times, and says the floor and indoor pool have more room on weekday mornings and early afternoons. Actual crowding can vary.
Peak times are weekday evenings (5–7 PM) and Saturday mornings. Outside those windows — especially weekday mornings and early afternoons — the floor and indoor pool have plenty of room.
The fall promotion says the pool deck closes ten minutes before the building closes and that holiday hours vary.
Pool deck closes 10 minutes before building close. Holiday hours vary.
The pool-schedule page says class reservations can be made in the MyY app or by logging into a member account. Check the live schedule for the activity you want.
Reservations open 48 hours before class time and can be made on the MyY App or by logging in to your member account .
